_about: CR-11 visual parity record. Each Playwright baseline (tests/e2e/__visual__/<env>/<surface>.png, tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts) is paired with the legacy capture it was compared against side by side (docs/ui/baseline/*.webp, the original Resuto app). Status "approved" may only be set by the owner after looking at the pair; "candidate" means the side-by-side was produced and reviewed by the implementing workstream but not yet approved. Composites: scratchpad evidence ws10a-data-qa/cr11-legacy-vs-new/.

local.determinism: two consecutive runs against the same baselines passed within 1 % (maxDiffPixelRatio 0.01)

docker.note: Recorded by the CI job "visual" in mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.56.1-noble: missing baselines are written and uploaded as the visual-baselines artifact; commit them after approval. Existing ones are enforced.

surfaces.notes: Hero, nav, CTAs and the service-view demo match the legacy layout and type; the demo floor shows more tables and its feed timestamps are masked.
RTL hero and navigation follow the legacy Arabic mobile capture.
New staff sign-in replaces the legacy single-password manager login; same brand and palette, different form (accounts per person).
Restaurant site hero and story restored (VP-06); photos and copy come from the published Studio revision.
Arabic RTL restaurant site at phone width.
Web ordering at phone width; legacy order page layout with the 2.0 cart bar.
QR table menu: hero, assistant card, search, categories and the bottom bill/cart bar match legacy; the 2.0 header shows the table and "Call waiter".
Staff shell and overview; legacy manager view had one page, 2.0 splits it into sections with the same chrome.
Floor overview (live) beside the legacy floor editor capture; the editor itself is the Floor Studio tab.
Orders board; no direct legacy counterpart (legacy showed orders inside the manager view).
Settings beside the legacy setup page.
Kitchen display lanes and service requests match; 2.0 opens full screen without the legacy sidebar (an intentional change from ws5).
